subject: Final push: pilot extension + closing credit request
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@moonbeam.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow-up & an offer to help close the pilot

Hi Sara —

Great running through the pilot results with you today. Moonbeam's throughput improvements on the inference latency test look really promising. I know you mentioned the board wants a short runway to validate integration before committing to Dedicated.

We typically see an additional 2–4 weeks of expanded usage do the trick — would Moonbeam be open to a 14-day pilot extension plus a close incentive from our side to make the operational evaluation frictionless?

My ask: if the extension would help you sign a 12-month commit, I can request an internal one-time usage credit to accelerate the decision. Ballpark I was thinking a $4k usage credit applied to hosted consumption (or equivalent token credit) plus the 14-day extension.

If that works, I’ll loop in Sales Ops and Legal to prepare the short DocuSign amendment. If you need a slightly larger sweetener to make this go across the line, tell me the number and I’ll escalate.

Next steps: Give me a quick thumbs-up and confirm who needs to sign, and I’ll open the approval thread.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

From: Sara Patel <sara@moonbeam.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Zach Li <zach@moonbeam.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & an offer to help close the pilot

Jonas — thank you, that would help a ton.

Short answer: yes. The team would take the 14-day extension. The board wants a conditional production trial and a path to sign by mid-December; we have a purchase decision window the week of Dec 13.

Sara (and Zach) will be the signers on our end. The $4k credit sounds in the right neighborhood — if you can make that official, we'll prioritize the legal review.

We'd prefer the credit be applied to hosted usage and visible on the invoice/portal so our finance team can reconcile.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Sara
Sara Patel
Head of ML Ops, Moonbeam Analytics
sara@moonbeam.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: internal: request approval for Moonbeam pilot extension + credit (DEAL-9342)

Ben / Monica —

Quick favor: Moonbeam (DEAL-9342) asked for a 14-day pilot extension and I proposed a $4k hosted-usage credit to help close before mid-Dec. They confirmed Sara & Zach will sign on their side if we can make the credit official and show it in the portal/invoice.

Attachments: moonbeam-pilot-proposal-v2.pdf (proposal summary), moonbeam-docusign-proposal.pdf (amendment draft).

Requesting: approval to issue a one-time $4,000 account credit applied to hosted consumption and to proceed with a DocuSign amendment. If approved, please confirm any usage cap or expiry you'd like to attach. I want to be clear on the guardrails (expiry date, max tokens, or per-day rate cap) before I send the DocuSign link.

Notes: The ACV here is $160k projected for year one if they move to Dedicated after the pilot; execs are watching the close window. We should keep this scoped to the pilot so we don't set a precedent for open-ended credits.

Thanks —
Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: internal: request approval for Moonbeam pilot extension + credit (DEAL-9342)

Thanks for the context, Jonas. I'm okay to approve a one-time credit up to $4,000 with the following constraints:

- Credit type: hosted-usage credit, non-refundable, applied automatically to the next invoice.
- Duration: 14-day extension from the current pilot end date.
- Usage cap: credit applies only up to 2,000,000 tokens consumed during the extension window; any overage billed at standard rates.
- Expiry: credit must be consumed during the extension; unused portion expires when the extension ends.
- Legal/Finance: Sales Ops will attach the amendment to DocuSign and include the credit clause; Legal sign-off not required for this one-off but note for Audit.

Please change the amendment to reflect the token cap and the invoice visibility request. Once updated, send me the DocuSign link and I'll route the backend credit issuance.

Ben Carter
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0136

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@moonbeam.ai>, Zach Li <zach@moonbeam.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & an offer to help close the pilot

Sara / Zach —

Good news: Sales Ops has approved a one-time $4,000 hosted-usage credit + the 14-day extension. Ben has asked we include a usage cap so the credit is limited to the first 2,000,000 tokens consumed during the extension; any overage will be billed normally. The credit will show on your portal/invoice for reconciliation.

I attached an updated amendment (moonbeam-docusign-proposal.pdf) and opened the DocuSign envelope here: https://app.docusign.com/transaction/ABC123-def456 — please have Sara and Zach sign and we’ll apply the credit on our side once the DocuSign completes.

If you want a slightly larger credit we can escalate to VP review, but this should be the fastest path to get you the runway you asked for.

Next steps: Sara, if you sign today we’ll push the extension live and apply the credit immediately.

Thanks —
Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183
